# Corner Accent

`decorative/corner-accent` &middot; section-level &middot; category: decorative

## Purpose

A section framed by an accent-colored corner on its top and left (or right) edges.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `content` | components (content-level) |  |

## Optional fields

None.

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Accent on the top and left edges.
- **right**: Accent on the top and right edges. Sets `corner: right`.
- **heavy**: A thicker accent (6px). Sets `thickness: 6px`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@theme.section.paddingY @theme.section.paddingX @theme.section.paddingY @theme.section.paddingX"` |
| `corner` | one of `left`, `right` | `"left"` |
| `color` | color | `"@theme.accent.color"` |
| `thickness` | length | `"@theme.accent.lineWidth"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Section borders honored. | Fine. | Background swaps on the brand surface, the accent border stays. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('decorative/corner-accent', {
  "content": [
    {
      "component": "content/heading",
      "data": {
        "text": "Repair for life"
      },
      "settings": {
        "level": "h3"
      }
    },
    {
      "component": "content/text",
      "data": {
        "text": "Wear a hole in it? Send it back and we will mend it for free, for as long as you own it."
      }
    }
  ]
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "decorative/corner-accent",
  "data": {
    "content": [
      {
        "component": "content/heading",
        "data": {
          "text": "Repair for life"
        },
        "settings": {
          "level": "h3"
        }
      },
      {
        "component": "content/text",
        "data": {
          "text": "Wear a hole in it? Send it back and we will mend it for free, for as long as you own it."
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```
